claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_modifier (class feature family)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Extra Attack is a permanent, always-on modification to the Attack action. It has no activation cost, no use-count resource, and no reset cadence. The only existing ClassFeatureMechanics family is 'activation', which requires all three of those fields. There is no honest way to fit a passive permanent buff into the activation family.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: scale_attack_count
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The v4 taxonomy already names this atom ('The number of attacks per Attack action grows with level. Example: Extra Attack (2 → 4)'), but the surface ClassFeatureMechanics type has no family that can emit it. Once a passive_modifier family exists, scale_attack_count is the correct effect atom to use here.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
